notes.zh:
- **插话立即生效**（#41）：任务进行中发的插话（插话发送、排队栏“立即发送”）马上显示在对话里，模型在当前任务的下一步就能看到，不再等这一轮结束才另开一轮。停止任务时，还没插进去的话会退回输入框
- **悬浮球和通知能回到正在运行的对话**（#39）：后台运行时点悬浮球或进度胶囊，打开的是正在运行的那个对话，不再新开对话；点通知栏的运行通知能回到 App。适配了 HyperOS 等系统对后台打开界面的限制
- **第三方识图模型能看到图片了**（#39）：之前不在内置列表里的识图模型（Gemini、GPT-4o、Qwen-VL、GLM-4V 等）会被当成纯文本模型，图片被替换成文字说明。现在按服务商接口返回的信息和模型名自动判断，模型编辑页可以手动设“图片输入”；图片发不到当前模型时，输入框会提示
- **App 内切换语言**（#40）：设置 → 通用 → 语言，可选跟随系统、中文、English，Android 10–12 也能用。新增语言只需要加一份翻译文件，欢迎贡献
- 这版没有在真机上测试过
- 仅支持 arm64-v8a，Android 10 及以上；正式签名，可直接覆盖安装，也可以在 设置 → 关于 里直接更新
notes.en:
- **Steering takes effect immediately** (#41): messages sent while a task runs show up in the chat right away and reach the model at its next step in the same task, instead of starting a new turn afterwards. Stopping the task returns undelivered text to the composer
- **Ball and notification open the running chat** (#39): tapping the floating ball or its capsule during a background run opens that chat instead of a new one; tapping the run notification brings the app back. Handles HyperOS-style background start limits
- **Third-party vision models now get images** (#39): vision models missing from the built-in table (Gemini, GPT-4o, Qwen-VL, GLM-4V…) were treated as text-only and images were replaced by a note. Image input is now detected from the provider's model list and the model name, with a manual override per model; the composer warns when images won't reach the current model
- **In-app language** (#40): Settings → General → Language (system / 中文 / English), also on Android 10–12. New languages only need a translation file — contributions welcome
- Not yet tested on a real device
